title: Can't Hurt Me
author: David Goggins
blurb: David Goggins grew up with an abusive father, poverty, racism and learning struggles. In his twenties he was nearly 300 pounds, working a dead-end job spraying for pests and feeling like a failure. Then he decided to change. He lost over 100 pounds to qualify for Navy SEAL training, survived multiple Hell Weeks, and went on to run brutal ultramarathons and set a pull-up record. Part memoir, part challenge, the book argues that most of us live far below our potential because our minds quit long before our bodies must. Goggins shares the mental tools he built along the way: facing hard truths, seeking discomfort on purpose, drawing strength from past wins, and treating failure as data. Each chapter ends with a challenge for the reader.
